intraday.structure: 1D last two confirmed fractal highs/lows (2 left, 2 right)
intraday.zones: Last red 4H source candle before a bullish close above the latest confirmed swing high (lower-wick demand), or last green candle before a bearish close below the latest confirmed swing low (full-range supply), refined to a matching 1H source candle
intraday.confirmation: 15m directional rejection or body-engulfing candle at first retest
intraday.entry: limit at proximal/entry line until filled or zone invalidation
intraday.stop: beyond distal/exit line by 0.50 x prior completed 4H ATR(14)
intraday.target: 2R if before next opposing zone; else 1.5R; otherwise skip
intraday.exit: TP or SL only; positions still open at test end are unresolved

scalp.structure: 4H last two confirmed fractal highs/lows (2 left, 2 right)
scalp.zones: Last red 1H source candle before a bullish close above the latest confirmed swing high (lower-wick demand), or last green candle before a bearish close below the latest confirmed swing low (full-range supply), refined to a matching 15m source candle
scalp.confirmation: 5m 9/20 EMA cross; both EMA slopes agree; daily UTC VWAP agrees; 4H trend agrees; nearest valid 15m-refined zone provides stop context
scalp.stop: beyond 15m-refined distal line by 0.50 x prior completed 4H ATR(14)
scalp.target: 2R if before next opposing zone; else 1.5R; otherwise skip
scalp.max_hold: None; TP or SL only; positions still open at test end are unresolved

conservative_rules: No lookahead: a source zone becomes available only after its displacement-confirmation candle closes
A zone is consumed after its first retest/confirmation window
If stop and target touch within the same candle, stop is counted first
Only one position per symbol per strategy; global 3% simultaneous risk cap
No forced time exits; unresolved positions are excluded from success/failure and return
Liquidation is not modelled because leverage and margin mode were not specified; the stop is assumed to execute first
Trading costs are ignored at the user's request
